summary: Removed the Tasks feature, including its page, navigation, API, and background progress tracking.
instructions: Open Chat, Dashboard, or Versions: Tasks is no longer in navigation. Old Tasks bookmarks and API requests return not found. Chat messages, command approvals, auto-approval, and existing history still work. Open pages receive the new version through the shared update monitor after restart, without discarding unfinished drafts or private forms. Tested with 156 Python tests, the self-test, desktop/mobile chat runtime checks, four-width layout checks, and Markdown rendering tests.
